searchQueries.title: Search keywords
searchQueries.description: Keywords matched against title and abstract (OR-combined). Example: multi-agent, retrieval augmented generation. Leave empty to browse categories only.

categories.title: arXiv categories
categories.description: Category codes (OR-combined), e.g. cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.CL, stat.ML. Combined with keywords using AND.

authors.title: Authors (optional)
authors.description: Author names to filter by (OR-combined), e.g. Yoshua Bengio.

dateFrom.title: Only papers on/after (optional)
dateFrom.description: ISO date, e.g. 2026-07-01. Filters on the submitted date (or updated date when sorting by last update).

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Newest submissions first is the monitoring default.

maxPapers.title: Max papers per run
maxPapers.description: Cap on papers returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip papers seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned arXiv IDs across runs and skip them. Turn on for scheduled monitoring so each run returns only new papers.
